Natives.name: Frames_Set
Natives.note: Set game frames, Params: 30,60 max 240FPS.

Natives.name: Frames_Get
Natives.note: Returns the configured game frame limit from the global context field +0x3C written by Frames_Set. Menu_Manager stores this value as its frame-rate limit.

Natives.name: Game_GetContext
Natives.note: Returns the global IGI game-context pointer at DAT_00567C8C. Retail callers use it to dispatch context callbacks and initialize the main game state.

Natives.name: Game_GetScriptContext
Natives.note: Returns *(void**)(Game_GetContext()+0x20), the script/task context initialized during game setup. Level_Start passes it through the script-data wrapper; the main-menu path pushes its return value as Menu_Manager's first argument.

Natives.name: Flow_SetState
Natives.note: Stores a pending flow state in game-context field +0x2C. The main loop consumes it, copies it to +0x28, clears the pending field, and dispatches state IDs 1 through 8. Flow_RequestEvent reaches this setter after converting its event ID.

Natives.name: Frames_GetUpdateCounter
Natives.note: Returns the update-loop counter at game-context field +0x34. Frames_Set resets it and the retail main loop increments it once per simulation/update pass; gameplay timeout code compares against this value.

Natives.name: Frames_GetTaskCounter
Natives.note: Returns the second task/processing counter at game-context field +0x38. Frames_Set resets it and the retail main loop increments it during the second processing pass.

Natives.name: Game_TimingBegin
Natives.note: Begins a nested timing interval: starts the retail timer when the timing depth is zero, then increments the depth counter. Level_Start and Game_Restart bracket their load work with this helper and Game_TimingEnd.

Natives.name: Game_TimingEnd
Natives.note: Ends a nested timing interval: decrements the depth counter and, at zero, adds elapsed timer ticks to game-context field +0x50 and clears the interval start timestamp.

Natives.name: GO_Player
Natives.note: Adds a player profile named 'name' to the config while a .cfg/GO script block is being read; subsequent GO_* settings apply to this profile. Param: name = profile display name (string). Use inside config/profile scripts, must come before that profile's GO_* settings. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_ActiveMission
Natives.note: Sets the active (last-played) mission number for the current player profile. Param: mission = mission index 1..14. Use in profile/config scripts after GO_Player. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_InRemap
Natives.signature: int GO_InRemap(int key1, int key2, int action);
Natives.note: Adds one input binding (key remap) to the current profile. Params: key1 = primary key code, key2 = secondary key code, action = in-game action id being bound. Use in input/config scripts, repeat once per binding. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_InMouInv
Natives.note: Toggles inverted mouse-look for the current profile. Param: invert = 1 invert Y axis, 0 normal. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_InMouSens
Natives.note: Sets mouse sensitivity for the current profile. Param: sensitivity = float multiplier as saved by the options screen. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_GfxDisp
Natives.note: Sets display-mode selection for the current profile. Param: displayMode = mode index from the retail display list (see Display_GetActiveMode/display table). Use in config scripts. igi.exe registers it with argc=3 at its site; the extra args go unused by the setter itself.

Natives.name: GO_GameLang
Natives.note: Sets game language for the current profile. Param: language = language index (retail ships English=0 and German builds use their own index). Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_GameDiff
Natives.note: Sets game difficulty for the current profile. Param: difficulty = 0 easy, 1 medium, 2 hard (retail order). Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: Config_IsGermany
Natives.note: RETURNS 1 when running the GERMAN retail build (censored variant), 0 otherwise. Takes no args. German builds gate blood/gore - check before forcing such effects.

Natives.name: Config_ResetGraphicOptions
Natives.note: Resets graphic options to FACTORY DEFAULTS - machine-verified field writes: width=0x280 (640), height=0x1E0 (480), plus clearing adjacent flag bytes on the profile record. Takes no script args. Registered by igi.exe as "Config_ResetGraphicOptions" (site 0x40352B) and called by retail MAINMENU.QVM. Use to restore 640x480 defaults programmatically.

Natives.name: GO_ContentControlPW
Natives.note: Menu-script setter form (argc=0): same address registered twice by igi.exe - site 0x4034C1 pushes str "Config_SetContentControlPassword" -> registrar 0x4B8890. Password comes from the script context, not an explicit arg. Returns 1.

Natives.name: Config_GetContentControlPassword
Natives.note: RETURNS the stored content-control (parental lock) password string. Takes no args. Compare against user input or pass to Config_VerifyContentControlPassword.

Natives.name: Config_VerifyContentControlPassword
Natives.note: Checks a password attempt against the stored content-control password. Param: password = string to test. RETURNS non-zero when correct, 0 when wrong. Use before unlocking violent-content options.

Natives.name: Config_IsContentControlPasswordEnabled
Natives.note: RETURNS 1 if a content-control password is SET (parental lock active), else 0. Takes no args. Use to decide whether to ask for the password.

Natives.name: GO_IsBlood
Natives.note: Toggles blood effects for the current profile. Param: blood = 1 on, 0 off. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_SoundSpeech
Natives.note: Sets speech volume for the current profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_SoundMusic
Natives.note: Sets music volume for the current profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_SoundFX
Natives.note: Sets sound-effects volume for the current profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_GfxDevice
Natives.note: Sets render-device (D3D device/GUID) selection for the current profile. Param: deviceIndex = index into the render-device list filled by Config_FillRenderDeviceListBox. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

Natives.name: GO_GfxGamma

Natives.signature: void AIAction_Patrol(int target, int mustBeZero, int flags);

Natives.name: AIAction_Combat
Natives.note: Orders the AI into COMBAT behaviour vs its current enemy. Param: param = combat argument from the calling script (retail guard scripts pass their combat target/context value). Use in AIEVENT_COMBAT branches.

Natives.name: AIAction_Dead
Natives.note: Runs the DEATH handling action for the AI (plays death, releases tasks). Param: param = death context value passed by retail scripts. Use in AIEVENT_DEAD handler.

Natives.name: AIAction_FallFlat
Natives.note: Knocks the AI flat on the ground (ragdoll-ish fall, e.g. after explosion/surrender). Params: two ints observed in retail calls (pass 0,0 unless mapping specific values). Use for scripted knockdowns.

Natives.name: AIAction_Activate
Natives.signature: void AIAction_Activate(int target, int param2, int flags);
Natives.note: Generic ACTIVATE action: sends the AI to activate/use an object (switch, door, alarm...). Params: target = object/task reference, param2 = secondary value (retail passes 0), flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use in AI handlers for alarm/objective responses.

Natives.name: AIAction_WalkToNode
Natives.note: Walks the AI to a nav node. Params: nodeId = graph/node id from the level nav data, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use for calm movement in AI scripts.

Natives.name: AIAction_RunToNode
Natives.note: Runs the AI to a nav node (fast). Same params as AIAction_WalkToNode: nodeId = node id, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Natives.name: AIAction_FireAtNode
Natives.signature: void AIAction_FireAtNode(int nodeId, int p1, int p2, int p3, int p4);
Natives.note: Makes the AI fire AT a nav-node position. Params: nodeId = target node id, remaining 4 args = firing stance/behaviour values observed in retail AI scripts (map before inventing values). Use in combat handlers when target is a position.

Natives.name: AIAction_FireAtTask
Natives.signature: void AIAction_FireAtTask(int taskId, int p1, int p2, int p3, int p4);
Natives.note: Makes the AI fire AT a task/object entity. Params: taskId = target task/entity id, remaining 4 args = firing behaviour values (same layout family as FireAtNode). Use in combat handlers when target is an entity.

Natives.name: AIAction_PlayAnimation
Natives.note: Plays an animation on the AI. Params: animationId = animation entry id (see AIFunction_AddAnimationEntry), flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Natives.name: AIAction_PlaySound
Natives.signature: void AIAction_PlaySound(int soundId, int param2, int flags);
Natives.note: Plays a sound from the AI (voice barks etc.). Params: soundId = sound/event id, param2 = observed 0 in retail, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Natives.name: AIAction_MoveToEvent
Natives.note: Moves the AI toward the source position of an EVENT it received. Params: eventId = AIEVENT_* whose position to move to, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use in event handlers (gunshot heard -> move there).

Natives.name: AIAction_LookAtEvent
Natives.note: Turns the AI to LOOK toward an event's source without moving. Params: eventId = AIEVENT_* value, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Natives.name: AIAction_Stunned
Natives.note: Stuns the AI (flashbang/knockout reaction). Params: param1 = stun duration/context value, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Natives.name: AIAction_KickGrenade
Natives.note: Kicks a nearby live grenade away (retail soldier behaviour). Param: param = grenade/context reference from the event. Use in grenade-event handlers.

Natives.name: AIAction_RunPanicking
Natives.note: Sends the AI into PANIC running (civilians under fire). Params: param1 = panic target/context, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Natives.name: AIAction_Idle
Natives.note: Puts the AI into IDLE (stands, resumes idle animation countdown). Param: idle context value (retail scripts pass their idle value). Use in AIEVENT_IDLE handler instead of Patrol for stationary guards.

Natives.name: AIAction_SetCombat
Natives.note: Force-sets the AI's COMBAT ENEMY/target. Param: enemyId = enemy entity/id to engage. Use to make an AI attack a specific target regardless of detection.

Natives.name: AIFunction_RemoveAlarmActions
Natives.note: Removes all queued ALARM-related actions from this AI (calms it down). Takes no args. Use to de-escalate an NPC you control.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetViewLength
Natives.note: Sets this AI's VIEW LENGTH - how far it can see. Param: length = view distance in engine units. Use in AI init (AIEVENT_CREATE) to buff/nerf vision.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmViewLength
Natives.note: Sets view length WHILE AN ALARM IS ON (separate stat from normal vision). Param: length = distance in engine units. Use in AI init.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetViewAlpha
Natives.note: Sets view ALPHA - the detection speed/gain of normal vision. Param: alpha = engine detection factor. Higher = spots player faster. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetViewGamma
Natives.note: Sets view GAMMA - secondary vision shaping factor for detection. Param: gamma = engine factor. Use in AI init alongside SetViewAlpha.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewLength
Natives.note: Sets SECONDARY view length (peripheral/short-range channel). Param: length = distance in engine units.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryAlarmViewLength
Natives.note: Sets secondary view length during alarms. Param: length = distance in engine units.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewAlpha
Natives.note: Sets secondary-view detection gain. Param: alpha = engine factor.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewGamma
Natives.note: Sets secondary-view gamma shaping factor. Param: gamma = engine factor.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetCurrentEventType
Natives.note: RETURNS the AIEVENT_* value currently being handled - the backbone of every AI script's if/else chain. Enum: CREATE=0, DELETE=1, DEAD=2, ANIMATION=3, IDLE=4, ALERT=5, ALERT_RESPONSE=6, COMBAT=7, ALARMON=8, ALARMOFF=9, WALK=10, GROUNDIMPACT=11, DOOR=12, FENCE=13, LADDER=14, TAKINGDAMAGE=15, GUNSHOT=16, GRENADETHROWN=17, GRENADELAND=18, FLASHBANG=19, GUNSHOTMISS=20, EXPLOSION=21, ENEMYDETECTION=22, FRIENDLYDETECTION=23. Takes no args.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetRandomValue
Natives.note: RETURNS a random value below 'max' (returns Real per retail table). Param: max = upper bound. Use for randomized behaviour delays/targets in AI scripts.

Natives.name: AIFunction_DefaultHandler
Natives.note: The default AI event handler: call this for any AIEVENT_* your script does not handle explicitly (retail template shows it as the else-branch body). Takes no args. Put inside every event if-else chain as fallback.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetEventPriority
Natives.note: Sets the priority of the CURRENT event being handled (decides which queued event wins). Param: priority = engine priority number. Use inside an event handler.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetInvulnerability
Natives.note: Makes this AI invulnerable. Param: onOff = 1 immune to damage, 0 normal. Great for boss/scripted NPCs. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE or anytime.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetInstantDeath
Natives.note: When on, any hit instantly kills this AI (no damage pooling). Param: onOff = 1 one-shot kills, 0 normal health. Use for scripted one-shot enemies.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetDeathAnimation
Natives.note: Overrides the death animation played when this AI dies. Param: animId = animation entry id. Use in AI init for custom deaths.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID
Natives.note: Binds an ALARM trigger object to this AI (which alarm switch it responds to/runs to). Param: id = alarm trigger id from the level. Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID(xx).

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID
Natives.note: Binds the ALARM CONTROL (the raised-alarm device) this AI uses. Param: id = alarm control id from the level. Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID(xx).

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess
Natives.note: Sets HOW the AI treats the alarm route. Param: access = AIALARMACCESS enum: BEFORECOMBAT=0 (run for the alarm first), AFTERCOMBAT=1 (fight first, raise alarm after). Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess(AIALARMACCESS_BEFORECOMBAT).

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetGunnerID
Natives.note: Assigns which mounted-gunner slot this AI mans. Param: gunnerId = gunner position id. Use in AI init for turret/mounted-gun NPCs.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerID
Natives.note: RETURNS the id of the alarm trigger bound to this AI (see AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID). Takes no args. Use in handlers to check which alarm applies.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlID
Natives.note: RETURNS the bound alarm-control id. Takes no args.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmAccess
Natives.note: RETURNS the current AIALARMACCESS mode: BEFORECOMBAT=0, AFTERCOMBAT=1. Takes no args.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerID
Natives.note: RETURNS this AI's assigned gunner slot id. Takes no args.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlStatus
Natives.note: RETURNS the status/state of the bound alarm control (raised/used state as tracked by the engine). Takes no args.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerStatus
Natives.note: RETURNS the status of this AI's gunner post (manned/state value). Takes no args.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue
Natives.note: Writes an AI-script integer variable. Params: varId = script variable index, value = new integer. Use for custom AI state communication between scripts.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetScriptIntegerValue
Natives.note: READS an AI-script integer variable written by AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue. Param: varId = variable index. RETURNS the integer.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetScriptRealValue
Natives.note: Writes an AI-script real (float) variable. Params: varId = script variable index, value = float. Pairs with AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue
Natives.note: READS an AI-script real (float) variable. Param: varId = variable index. RETURNS the float.

Natives.name: AIFunction_IsEventBehind
Natives.note: RETURNS non-zero if the current event came from BEHIND the AI (direction test used for reaction animations). Takes no script args per retail table (engine reads an internal slot via ebp+8). Use in alert/detection handlers.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetEventDistance
Natives.note: RETURNS the DISTANCE to the source of the current event (Real). Takes no args. Use inside event handlers e.g. 'if gunshot closer than X then investigate'.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerDistance
Natives.note: RETURNS the distance between this AI and its bound ALARM TRIGGER (Real). Takes no args. Use to decide running vs fighting for the alarm.

Natives.name: AIFunction_SetAnimationInterval
Natives.note: Sets playback INTERVAL for an animation entry. Params: entryIndex = animation entry added via AddAnimationEntry, interval = frame/tick interval. Use when tuning scripted animations.

Natives.name: AIFunction_AddAnimationEntry
Natives.note: Adds an animation ENTRY to this AI's available set (builds the pick-list GetAnimationToPlay draws from). Params: animationId = animation resource id, data = entry config value. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE before playing custom animations.

Natives.name: AIFunction_GetAnimationToPlay
Natives.note: RETURNS which animation entry the engine decided to play for the current event/action (useful to log or override reactions). Per retail table takes no script args; machine code also touches an [ebp+8] slot (internal context).

Natives.name: AIFunction_SendResponse
Natives.note: Sends the AI's RESPONSE to the current event (used for ALERT_RESPONSE chains so buddy AIs react too). Takes no args. Call inside alert handlers.
